test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which Indian airline got grounded in April 2019?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Jet Airways.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jet Airways** stop operations in** April 2019. **
 
• The company has declared plan to proceed operations in **early 2022. **
 
• On the **29th anniversary** of its authorizing on **5 May 2022**, it performed a test flight, which is a step in obtaining an **Air Operators Permit (AOP)**.
 
• Jet Airways is be one of most important Indian airlines established on **1st April 1992.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7942286a5931004284150dcea0b12e118c1e85bdb992f62e7df8c56a2e1fe0b6.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​ Air Sahara was established** in 1991 and made its inaugural flights in late 1993**.
 
• The airline was established** as a private company by Rahul Bhatia of InterGlobe Enterprises and Rakesh Gangwal in 2006.**
 
• Kingfisher Airlines was started** in 2003** and closed operations when its license was **cancelled on 20 October 2012.**
